audit.why: TRICKY 7/10 with Kled carry threat 7.5/10 fits a 49.53% lane where he owns levels 2-5 and Ryze only reclaims it at two mana items. The mirror made no difficulty change.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 read Ryze in both layers while its own caption (whys[4]) describes Chaaaaaaaarge!!! closing any gap and resetting the skirmish; 2+ items read Kled while whys[6] says Ryze out-grinds him at two items. Both captions argued the opposite of the chart.
audit.why: R is his spike and Seraph's is yours. The mirror already flipped exactly these two rows and deliberately left rows 2, 4 and 6 of the packet chart alone where the captions support the current side.
audit.corrected: phases[4]/win[4] Ryze -> Kled with rating 7/10 -> 3/10; phases[6]/win[6] Kled -> Ryze with rating 4/10 -> 7/10. Matched pairs, one group. Rows 1, 3 and 5 intentionally left as the mirror left them.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet defect: the page never names Kled's abilities beyond Bear Trap. 'auto-W chain' is Violent Tendencies, the second dash is Jousting, and the ult is spelled Chaaaaarge!!! (real: Chaaaaaaaarge!!!). No cooldowns anywhere, and the R shield is never mentioned.
audit.why: Violent Tendencies is a four-attack burst on 13s at rank 1 with an auto reset — the wind-up is the burst tell. Jousting (13s at rank 1) dashes through and can be recast to return, so it beats a reactive root twice. Chaaaaaaaarge!!! is 140s at rank 1, travels 3500 and grants a shield, which eats the burst window you were about to spend.
audit.corrected: Real names and cooldowns written into whys[1], whys[2], spikes[1], spikes[2] and mid, with the shield stated as something to force out before committing and the Violent Tendencies wind-up named as the step-back cue.

edits.before: Mounted Kled's auto-W chain after a Q grab dismounts you faster than your W root can stop him — concede the trade window and farm.
edits.after: Violent Tendencies hands him four fast attacks after a Bear Trap yank, out-damaging your rotation before the root matters — concede and farm.

edits.before: His full engage pattern (Q grab into mounted autos into dismount brawl) beats your E-Flux combo cycling — hold W and disengage with Phase Rush.
edits.after: Bear Trap into Violent Tendencies into a Jousting re-dash beats your cycling, and Jousting is 13s at rank 1 — trade only once he has spent it.

edits.before: Kled's full mounted kit comes online — his Q grab into auto-W chain can instantly dismount him and cancel your E-Flux pattern.
edits.after: Kled's mounted kit completes: Bear Trap yanks you in and Violent Tendencies burns four fast attacks — its wind-up is the tell.

edits.before: His Chaaaaarge!!! engage collapses distance instantly — position near walls and pre-place W root so Phase Rush kites him off you.
edits.after: Chaaaaaaaarge!!! crosses 3500 units on 140s and shields him — make him spend the shield before you commit, and pre-aim W on his charge angle.

edits.before: Once Kled completes his mounted kit at level 3, his Q-grab into auto-W chain can strip your HP faster than your E-Q-W combo recovers it — he outright wins the extended trade here. Respect it and treat W as a defensive tool, not setup: save the root for the moment he lands Beartrap so Phase Rush kicks in and you walk out. At level 6 Realm Warp adds macro pressure and escape, and Kled's Chaaaaarge!!! becomes readable with wall-awareness — pre-aim W toward the angle he charges from and proc Phase Rush the instant you get hit; that converts his all-in into a free combo window for you.
edits.after: Once Kled completes his mounted kit at level 3, Bear Trap into Violent Tendencies strips your HP faster than your rotation recovers it — he wins the extended trade outright. Treat Rune Prison as a defensive tool, not setup: hold it for the moment the trap lands so Phase Rush carries you out. Jousting is 13 seconds at rank 1 and he can recast it to dash back through you, so a reactive root gets beaten twice. At 6 Chaaaaaaaarge!!! is 140 seconds and brings a shield with it — pre-aim W on his charge angle, proc Phase Rush the instant it connects, and let the shield expire before you spend your burst.

notes: Kled's abilities were unnamed throughout (packet defect) and the ult was misspelled Chaaaaarge!!!. The two mechanical facts the page never carried: Chaaaaaaaarge!!! grants a shield, so burst spent into the charge is wasted, and Jousting can be recast to return through you, which is why a reactive Rune Prison loses. Level chart rows 6 and 2+ items flipped in matched pairs to agree with the mirror and with their own captions; rows the mirror deliberately left disagreeing with the packet (Level 2, Levels 4-5, First item) I also left, so the two directions stay identical.
